title: How to send and receive money
summary: Explains how to send and receive money using the Everyone Pay app: select/add a contact, enter an amount and optional note, choose Standard (completes within 12 hours; no instant fee) or Instant (delivers right away; $0.75 or 0.75% fee), then confirm and submit. It also covers notification/activity updates and settlement timing (Standard: within 12 hours after sender submits; Instant: immediate).
